No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. return: The identical nums array after applying all replacements in order, preserving positions of every unaffected value.
mutation_aliasing: Intentionally writes nums in place and returns its original identity; caller aliases observe changes. Length is unchanged. operations and every operation row remain unchanged. numeric: Values are exact map keys, never arithmetically transformed. Deleting old mapping before installing new preserves a one-to-one value-to-index invariant after each operation. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: Expected O(n+m+1) time and O(n+1) auxiliary space for n values and m operations, including JavaScript temporary constructor pairs.
